_spec: hopeOS body-puppet MOVEMENT contract v1 (body sibling of the face contract). One file = one puppet body. Keypoint positions never cross the human->puppet boundary; channels carry torso-normalized MEASURES (sdk/interaction/body-measures.js) and discrete GESTURE events (sdk/interaction/body-gestures.js). The animal-sync TRANSLATION lives here too: stance mapping, limb correspondence, gait rules, and movement constraints. Executable by sdk/interaction/quadruped.js.

alt_spaces.movenet-17: body-measures.js MOVENET_17 map — same formulas, swap the index map

human.hands_note: segmented finger tracking (HandLandmarker 21-pt) is a RESERVED lane: fox toes have no rig; fingers may later drive ear/tail flicks. Face channels come from the face contract on the same page (b_Neck_04/b_Head_05 accept head.rot directly).
human.smoothing: One-Euro on the HUMAN side only (BodyProbe); puppet applies raw
human.gesture_source: BodyGestureDetector events: jump, squat, kick(side), dodge, leanL/R, runInPlace
calibration_ritual: arms straight out + bent 2s -> extend bent_deg/straight_deg (defaults usually fine)

puppet.skeleton_note: Khronos Fox. QUADRUPED: the 'Arm' bones ARE the front legs.
puppet.clip_rates_hz: Walk cycle ~= 1.04s at rate 1 (2 full step-pairs); rate scales with human cadence
puppet.scale_note: fox bbox diagonal 175.5 units; lab normalizes to ~1.5 world units

stance_translation.rule: The STANDING human is the fox's NEUTRAL all-fours stance. The human never needs to crawl: upright = fox standing on four legs; human limbs map by anatomical correspondence (arms->front legs, legs->hind legs) — the crawl-scheme direct mapping shown most intuitive in quadruped-embodiment studies (Become the Beast, arXiv:2603.15428).
stance_translation.sides: anatomical: player LEFT arm -> fox LEFT front leg. In the mirrored selfie view player-left appears screen-left; the lab renders the fox facing AWAY (same heading as player) so left/right feel identical.
stance_translation.advanced_mode_reserved: on-all-fours human capture (wrists become front paws directly) — same channels, different raise reference; contract shape unchanged

channels.meaning: lift fox front-left paw (give-paw when isolated; gait step when cycled)
lean left/right STEERS the fox's heading while walking
fox looks where you look; merges the face stack onto the body rig

gait.rule: Each human limb raise->lower cycle past the step threshold = ONE step of the corresponding fox leg. Alternating limb cycles sustain locomotion: cadence (steps/sec over a sliding 2s window) drives Walk clip weight + playbackRate + forward speed. Your spec verbatim: move left arm -> fox front-left leg steps and the fox walks forward.
gait.forward_speed: cadence * stride; stride = 0.32 fox-lengths per step, clamped 1.4 fox-lengths/s
gait.idle_clip_behavior: crossfade to Survey; individual limb raises still play through additive bone offsets (give-paw preserved when not walking)

jump.impl: Run clip burst 0.6s + root hop (parabolic y, 0.35 fox-heights) + forward lunge 0.5 fox-lengths

squat.impl: body.crouch channel already carries it continuously; gesture event just gates the pounce-ready ear/tail pose

dash.impl: Run clip while active, forward speed x2.2

kick.impl: burst additive rotation on that side's hind chain (b_*Leg01, 55deg, 350ms out-back), scaled by vel.legX.tip

constraints.additive_over_clip: per-limb offsets apply AFTER AnimationMixer update each frame (clip pose + additive), weight-faded 0 as Walk weight -> 1 for stepping legs so gait animation is never fought
constraints.clamps: every bone_rot_additive channel carries clamp_deg; axis+sign are LAB-VERIFIED fields (bone local axes are asset facts, verify in foxlab before trusting)
constraints.ground_lock: root y only changes via crouch/jump channels — no drift
constraints.hold_on_loss: pose lost -> freeze channels, decay to Survey after idle_after_ms; never snap
